events.verdict: George (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Miller's (CHA) drive to the basket and shot attempt and the contact is incidental.
Diabat? (CHA) extends his hands into Yabusele's (PHI) back, illegally moving him off of his spot during the rebound.
Ball (CHA) rests his hands on Lowry's (PHI) back as Lowry moves to set the screen and Lowry is not dislodged from his position as a result of the marginal contact.
George's (PHI) releases from Martin (CHA) before making the pass.
Ball (CHA) legally contests Martin's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Ball (CHA) does not bring his left hand underneath the ball or bring his dribble to a pause.
McCain (PHI) brushes Miller's (CHA) arm as he briefly loses his balance on his own.
Yabusele (PHI) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
McCain (PHI) legally contests Martin's (CHA) jump shot attempt and the contact after the release is marginal.
Lowry (PHI) initiates contact to Diabate's (CHA) arm, affecting his ability to secure the loose ball.
Martin (CHA) moves alongside of George's (PHI) path to the basket and the contact during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Williams (CHA) rests and promptly removes his forearm from Yabusele's (PHI) back during the put-back attempt at the basket and the contact is marginal.
Martin (PHI) makes direct contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it from Ball's (CHA) grasp.
Martin (PHI) and Ball (CHA) engage and disengage away from the ball and the contact is marginal.
Martin (PHI) legally contests Miller's (CHA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Martin (CHA) commits a take foul on McCain (PHI).
Ball (CHA) firms up in Yabusele's (PHI) path and does not delivery any illegal contact when setting the screen.
Williams (CH)A commits a take foul on Lowry (PHI).
Lowry (PHI) briefly rests his hands on Curry's (CHA) sides during the throw-in and the marginal contact dissolves shortly thereafter.
McCain (PHI) grazes Ball's (CHA) right arm before he enters his shooting motion and the contact is marginal. He then legally contests Ball's jump shot attempt.
Martin (CHA) legally contests George's (PHI) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Martin (PHI) moves underneath Ball (CHA) during his layup attempt and initiates lower body contact that affects his ability to return to the floor.
Diabat? (CHA) wraps his left arm around Yabusele's (PHI) side and the contact affects Yabusele's FOM after setting the pick.
Yabusele (PHI) and Miller (CHA) engage and disengage in the paint and the contact is marginal.
Williams (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position during McCain's (PHI) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Yabusele (PHI) steps to his left and leans into Williams' (CHA) path, delivering contact that dislodges Williams as he cuts off ball.
Ball (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position during McCain's (PHI) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Martin (CHA) lowers his arm and initiates illegal contact to Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) arm that affects his dunk attempt.
Martin's (PHI) briefly wraps his arm around Miller's (CHA) back, but immediately removes it.
Ball (CHA) steps back and legally pivots off of his left foot before passing.
The shot clock expires with Charlotte still in possession of the ball.

A foul called on Ball (CHA) for contact with McCain (PHI) was challenged by CHA and deemed successful. Ball is in a legal defensive position in McCain's path as McCain attempts a basketball move to get around him, creating body contact. Ball simultaneously reaches forward and dislodges the ball from McCain's control. The body contact on the play, which looks like a foul, is largely created by McCain as he runs into Ball. And while Ball does reach across McCain's path, since he gets to the ball and dislodges it, he is not illegally impeding McCain's progress.
Williams (CHA) places his forearm against Martin's (PHI) body, but the contact is marginal.
Martin (PHI) legally contests Miller's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Curry (CHA) makes clean contact with the ball to steal it away from Yabusele (PHI) during the rebound.
Martin (PHI) brings his hands to rest on Williams' (CHA) right arm during the free throw and Williams loses his balance on his own.
Martin (CHA) and Lowry (PHI) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Williams (CHA) commits a take foul on Martin (PHI).

Yabusele (PHI) moves laterally into Williams' (CHA) path and initiates contact that affects Williams' SQBR. The illegal contact occurs prior to Williams gathering the ball and entering his upward shooting motion.
Williams (CHA) crosses the plane of the free throw line before the ball can make contact with the rim.
Diabat? (CHA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Miller (CHA) deflects the throw-in and any ensuing contact with Yabusele (PHI) is incidental.
